verses.arabicText: كٓهيعٓصٓ
verses.transliteration: Kaf-ha-ya-ain-sad
verses.translation: Kãf-Ha-Ya-’Aĩn- Ṣãd

verses.arabicText: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
verses.transliteration: Dhik'ru raḥmati rabbika ʿabdahu zakariyyā
verses.translation: ˹This is˺ a reminder of your Lord’s mercy to His servant Zachariah

verses.arabicText: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Idh nādā rabbahu nidāan khafiyyā
verses.translation: when he cried out to his Lord privately

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi innī wahana l-ʿaẓmu minnī wa-ish'taʿala r-rasu shaybaw-walam akun biduʿāika rabbi shaqiyyā
verses.translation: saying, “My Lord! Surely my bones have become brittle, and grey hair has spread across my head, but I have never been disappointed in my prayer to You, my Lord

verses.arabicText: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wa-innī khif'tu l-mawāliya miw-warāī wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiran fahab lī mil-ladunka waliyyā
verses.translation: And I am concerned about ˹the faith of˺ my relatives after me, since my wife is barren. So grant me, by Your grace, an heir

verses.arabicText: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Yarithunī wayarithu min āli yaʿqūba wa-ij'ʿalhu rabbi raḍiyyā
verses.translation: who will inherit ˹prophethood˺ from me and the family of Jacob, and make him, O Lord, pleasing ˹to You˺!”

verses.arabicText: يَـٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Yāzakariyyā innā nubashiruka bighulāmin us'muhu yaḥyā lam najʿal lahu min qablu samiyyā
verses.translation: ˹The angels announced,˺ “O Zachariah! Indeed, We give you the good news of ˹the birth of˺ a son, whose name will be John—a name We have not given to anyone before.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī ghulāmuw-wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiraw-waqad balaghtu mina l-kibari ʿitiyyā
verses.translation: He wondered, “My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I have become extremely old?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًٔا
verses.transliteration: Qāla kadhālika qāla rabbuka huwa ʿalayya hayyinuw-waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayā
verses.translation: An angel replied, “So will it be! Your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me, just as I created you before, when you were nothing!’”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَـٰثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi ij'ʿal lī āyatan qāla āyatuka allā tukallima n-nāsa thalātha layālin sawiyyā
verses.translation: Zachariah said, “My Lord! Grant me a sign.” He responded, “Your sign is that you will not ˹be able to˺ speak to people for three nights, despite being healthy.”

verses.arabicText: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Fakharaja ʿalā qawmihi mina l-miḥ'rābi fa-awḥā ilayhim an sabbiḥū buk'rataw-waʿashiyyā
verses.translation: So he came out to his people from the sanctuary, signalling to them to glorify ˹Allah˺ morning and evening

verses.arabicText: يَـٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Yāyaḥyā khudhi l-kitāba biquwwatiw-waātaynāhu l-ḥuk'ma ṣabiyyā
verses.translation: ˹It was later said,˺ “O John! Hold firmly to the Scriptures.” And We granted him wisdom while ˹he was still˺ a child

verses.arabicText: وَحَنَانًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةً ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Waḥanānam-mil-ladunnā wazakataw-wakāna taqiyyā
verses.translation: as well as purity and compassion from Us. And he was God-fearing

verses.arabicText: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wabarran biwālidayhi walam yakun jabbāran ʿaṣiyyā
verses.translation: and kind to his parents. He was neither arrogant nor disobedient

verses.arabicText: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wasalāmun ʿalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamūtu wayawma yub'ʿathu ḥayyā
verses.translation: Peace be upon him the day he was born, and the day of his death, and the day he will be raised back to life

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi maryama idhi intabadhat min ahlihā makānan sharqiyyā
verses.translation: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Mary when she withdrew from her family to a place in the east

verses.arabicText: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Fa-ittakhadhat min dūnihim ḥijāban fa-arsalnā ilayhā rūḥanā fatamathala lahā basharan sawiyyā
verses.translation: screening herself off from them. Then We sent to her Our angel, ˹Gabriel,˺ appearing before her as a man, perfectly formed

verses.arabicText: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Qālat innī aʿūdhu bil-raḥmāni minka in kunta taqiyyā
verses.translation: She appealed, “I truly seek refuge in the Most Compassionate from you! ˹So leave me alone˺ if you are God-fearing.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَـٰمًا زَكِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Qāla innamā anā rasūlu rabbiki li-ahaba laki ghulāman zakiyyā
verses.translation: He responded, “I am only a messenger from your Lord, ˹sent˺ to bless you with a pure son.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Qālat annā yakūnu lī ghulāmuw-walam yamsasnī basharuw-walam aku baghiyyā
verses.translation: She wondered, “How can I have a son when no man has ever touched me, nor am I unchaste?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَّقْضِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Qāla kadhāliki qāla rabbuki huwa ʿalayya hayyinuw-walinajʿalahu āyatal-lilnnāsi waraḥmatam-minnā wakāna amram-maqḍiyyā
verses.translation: He replied, “So will it be! Your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me. And so will We make him a sign for humanity and a mercy from Us.’ It is a matter ˹already˺ decreed.”

verses.arabicText: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Faḥamalathu fa-intabadhat bihi makānan qaṣiyyā
verses.translation: So she conceived him and withdrew with him to a remote place

verses.arabicText: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَـٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًا مَّنسِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Fa-ajāahā l-makhāḍu ilā jidh'ʿi n-nakhlati qālat yālaytanī mittu qabla hādhā wakuntu nasyam-mansiyyā
verses.translation: Then the pains of labour drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She cried, “Alas! I wish I had died before this, and was a thing long forgotten!”

verses.arabicText: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Fanādāhā min taḥtihā allā taḥzanī qad jaʿala rabbuki taḥtaki sariyyā
verses.translation: So a voice reassured her from below her, “Do not grieve! Your Lord has provided a stream at your feet

verses.arabicText: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَـٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wahuzzī ilayki bijidh'ʿi n-nakhlati tusāqiṭ ʿalayki ruṭaban janiyyā
verses.translation: And shake the trunk of this palm tree towards you, it will drop fresh, ripe dates upon you

verses.arabicText: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Fakulī wa-ish'rabī waqarrī ʿaynan fa-immā tarayinna mina l-bashari aḥadan faqūlī innī nadhartu lilrraḥmāni ṣawman falan ukallima l-yawma insiyyā
verses.translation: So eat and drink, and put your heart at ease. But if you see any of the people, say, ‘I have vowed silence to the Most Compassionate, so I am not talking to anyone today.’”

verses.arabicText: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًٔا فَرِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Fa-atat bihi qawmahā taḥmiluhu qālū yāmaryamu laqad ji'ti shayan fariyyā
verses.translation: Then she returned to her people, carrying him. They said ˹in shock˺, “O Mary! You have certainly done a horrible thing

verses.arabicText: يَـٰٓأُخْتَ هَـٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Yāukh'ta hārūna mā kāna abūki im'ra-a sawiw-wamā kānat ummuki baghiyyā
verses.translation: O sister of Aaron! Your father was not an indecent man, nor was your mother unchaste.”

verses.arabicText: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Fa-ashārat ilayhi qālū kayfa nukallimu man kāna fī l-mahdi ṣabiyyā
verses.translation: So she pointed to the baby. They exclaimed, “How can we talk to someone who is an infant in the cradle?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Qāla innī ʿabdu l-lahi ātāniya l-kitāba wajaʿalanī nabiyyā
verses.translation: ˹Jesus˺ declared, “I am truly a servant of Allah. He has destined me to be given the Scripture and to be a prophet

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَـٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wajaʿalanī mubārakan ayna mā kuntu wa-awṣānī bil-ṣalati wal-zakati mā dum'tu ḥayyā
verses.translation: He has made me a blessing wherever I go, and bid me to establish prayer and give alms-tax as long as I live

verses.arabicText: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wabarran biwālidatī walam yajʿalnī jabbāran shaqiyyā
verses.translation: and to be kind to my mother. He has not made me arrogant or defiant

verses.arabicText: وَٱلسَّلَـٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wal-salāmu ʿalayya yawma wulidttu wayawma amūtu wayawma ub'ʿathu ḥayyā
verses.translation: Peace be upon me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I will be raised back to life!”

verses.arabicText: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Dhālika ʿīsā ub'nu maryama qawla l-ḥaqi alladhī fīhi yamtarūn
verses.translation: That is Jesus, son of Mary. ˹And this is˺ a word of truth, about which they dispute

verses.arabicText: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍ ۖ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.transliteration: Mā kāna lillahi ay-yattakhidha miw-waladin sub'ḥānahu idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūn
verses.translation: It is not for Allah to take a son! Glory be to Him. When He decrees a matter, He simply tells it, “Be!” And it is

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna l-laha rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭum-mus'taqīm
verses.translation: ˹Jesus also declared,˺ “Surely Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”

verses.arabicText: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylul-lilladhīna kafarū mim-mashhadi yawmin ʿaẓīm
verses.translation: Yet their ˹various˺ groups have differed among themselves ˹about him˺, so woe to the disbelievers when they face a tremendous Day

verses.arabicText: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَـٰكِنِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Asmiʿ bihim wa-abṣir yawma yatūnanā lākini ẓ-ẓālimūna l-yawma fī ḍalālim-mubīn
verses.translation: How clearly will they hear and see on the Day they will come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are clearly astray

verses.arabicText: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-andhir'hum yawma l-ḥasrati idh quḍiya l-amru wahum fī ghaflatiw-wahum lā yu'minūn
verses.translation: And warn them ˹O Prophet˺ of the Day of Regret, when all matters will be settled, while they are ˹engrossed˺ in heedlessness and disbelief

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innā naḥnu narithu l-arḍa waman ʿalayhā wa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūn
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We Who will succeed the earth and whoever is on it. And to Us they will ˹all˺ be returned

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi ib'rāhīma innahu kāna ṣiddīqan-nabiyyā
verses.translation: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Abraham. He was surely a man of truth and a prophet

verses.arabicText: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًٔا
verses.transliteration: Idh qāla li-abīhi yāabati lima taʿbudu mā lā yasmaʿu walā yub'ṣiru walā yugh'nī ʿanka shayā
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when he said to his father, “O dear father! Why do you worship what can neither hear nor see, nor benefit you at all

verses.arabicText: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Yāabati innī qad jāanī mina l-ʿil'mi mā lam yatika fa-ittabiʿ'nī ahdika ṣirāṭan sawiyyā
verses.translation: O dear father! I have certainly received some knowledge which you have not received, so follow me and I will guide you to the Straight Path

verses.arabicText: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَصِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Yāabati lā taʿbudi sh-shayṭāna inna sh-shayṭāna kāna lilrraḥmāni ʿaṣiyyā
verses.translation: O dear father! Do not worship Satan. Surely Satan is ever rebellious against the Most Compassionate

verses.arabicText: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَـٰنِ وَلِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Yāabati innī akhāfu ay-yamassaka ʿadhābum-mina r-raḥmāni fatakūna lilshayṭāni waliyyā
verses.translation: O dear father! I truly fear that you will be touched by a torment from the Most Compassionate, and become Satan’s companion ˹in Hell˺.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Qāla arāghibun anta ʿan ālihatī yāib'rāhīmu la-il-lam tantahi la-arjumannaka wa-uh'jur'nī maliyyā
verses.translation: He threatened, “How dare you reject my idols, O Abraham! If you do not desist, I will certainly stone you ˹to death˺. So be gone from me for a long time!”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Qāla salāmun ʿalayka sa-astaghfiru laka rabbī innahu kāna bī ḥafiyyā
verses.translation: Abraham responded, “Peace be upon you! I will pray to my Lord for your forgiveness. He has truly been Most Gracious to me

verses.arabicText: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wa-aʿtazilukum wamā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi wa-adʿū rabbī ʿasā allā akūna biduʿāi rabbī shaqiyyā
verses.translation: As I distance myself from ˹all of˺ you and from whatever you invoke besides Allah, I will ˹continue to˺ call upon my Lord ˹alone˺, trusting that I will never be disappointed in invoking my Lord.”

verses.arabicText: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Falammā iʿ'tazalahum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi wahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wakullan jaʿalnā nabiyyā
verses.translation: So after he had left them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We granted him Isaac and Jacob, and made each of them a prophet

verses.arabicText: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wawahabnā lahum mir-raḥmatinā wajaʿalnā lahum lisāna ṣid'qin ʿaliyyā
verses.translation: We showered them with Our mercy, and blessed them with honourable mention

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi mūsā innahu kāna mukh'laṣaw-wakāna rasūlan-nabiyyā
verses.translation: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Moses. He was truly a chosen man, and was a messenger and a prophet

verses.arabicText: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَـٰهُ نَجِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wanādaynāhu min jānibi ṭ-ṭūri l-aymani waqarrabnāhu najiyyā
verses.translation: We called him from the right side of Mount Ṭûr, and drew him near, speaking ˹with him˺ directly

verses.arabicText: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ نَبِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wawahabnā lahu mir-raḥmatinā akhāhu hārūna nabiyyā
verses.translation: And We appointed for him—out of Our grace—his brother, Aaron, as a prophet

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi is'māʿīla innahu kāna ṣādiqa l-waʿdi wakāna rasūlan-nabiyyā
verses.translation: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Ishmael. He was truly a man of his word, and was a messenger and a prophet

verses.arabicText: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wakāna yamuru ahlahu bil-ṣalati wal-zakati wakāna ʿinda rabbihi marḍiyyā
verses.translation: He used to urge his people to pray and give alms-tax. And his Lord was well pleased with him

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi id'rīsa innahu kāna ṣiddīqan-nabiyyā
verses.translation: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Enoch. He was surely a man of truth and a prophet

verses.arabicText: وَرَفَعْنَـٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Warafaʿnāhu makānan ʿaliyyā
verses.translation: And We elevated him to an honourable status

verses.arabicText: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا ۩
verses.transliteration: Ulāika alladhīna anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhim mina n-nabiyīna min dhurriyyati ādama wamimman ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥiw-wamin dhurriyyati ib'rāhīma wa-is'rāīla wamimman hadaynā wa-ij'tabaynā idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātu r-raḥmāni kharrū sujjadaw-wabukiyyā
verses.translation: Those were ˹some of˺ the prophets who Allah has blessed from among the descendants of Adam, and of those We carried with Noah ˹in the Ark˺, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those We ˹rightly˺ guided and chose. Whenever the revelations of the Most Compassionate were recited to them, they fell down, prostrating and weeping

verses.arabicText: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
verses.transliteration: Fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun aḍāʿū ṣ-ṣalata wa-ittabaʿū sh-shahawāti fasawfa yalqawna ghayyā
verses.translation: But they were succeeded by generations who neglected prayer and followed their lusts and so will soon face the evil consequences

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا
verses.transliteration: Illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata walā yuẓ'lamūna shayā
verses.translation: As for those who repent, believe, and do good, it is they who will be admitted into Paradise, never being denied any reward

verses.arabicText: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿada r-raḥmānu ʿibādahu bil-ghaybi innahu kāna waʿduhu matiyyā
verses.translation: ˹They will be in˺ the Gardens of Eternity, promised in trust by the Most Compassionate to His servants. Surely His promise will be fulfilled

verses.arabicText: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَـٰمًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan illā salāmaw-walahum riz'quhum fīhā buk'rataw-waʿashiyyā
verses.translation: There they will never hear any idle talk—only ˹greetings of˺ peace. And there they will have their provisions morning and evening

verses.arabicText: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Til'ka l-janatu allatī nūrithu min ʿibādinā man kāna taqiyyā
verses.translation: That is Paradise, which We will grant to whoever is devout among Our servants

verses.arabicText: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wamā natanazzalu illā bi-amri rabbika lahu mā bayna aydīnā wamā khalfanā wamā bayna dhālika wamā kāna rabbuka nasiyyā
verses.translation: “We only descend by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs whatever is before us, and whatever is behind us, and everything in between. And your Lord is never forgetful

verses.arabicText: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَـٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Rabbu s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā fa-uʿ'bud'hu wa-iṣ'ṭabir liʿibādatihi hal taʿlamu lahu samiyyā
verses.translation: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the heavens, and the earth, and everything in between. So worship Him ˹alone˺, and be steadfast in His worship. Do you know of anyone equal to Him ˹in His attributes˺?”

verses.arabicText: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wayaqūlu l-insānu a-idhā mā mittu lasawfa ukh'raju ḥayyā
verses.translation: Yet ˹some˺ people ask ˹mockingly˺, “After I die, will I really be raised to life again?”

verses.arabicText: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًٔا
verses.transliteration: Awalā yadhkuru l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min qablu walam yaku shayā
verses.translation: Do ˹such˺ people not remember that We created them before, when they were nothing

verses.arabicText: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Fawarabbika lanaḥshurannahum wal-shayāṭīna thumma lanuḥ'ḍirannahum ḥawla jahannama jithiyyā
verses.translation: By your Lord ˹O Prophet˺! We will surely gather them along with the devils, and then set them around Hell on their knees

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عِتِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Thumma lananziʿanna min kulli shīʿatin ayyuhum ashaddu ʿalā r-raḥmāni ʿitiyyā
verses.translation: Then We will certainly begin by dragging out of every group the ones most defiant to the Most Compassionate

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Thumma lanaḥnu aʿlamu bi-alladhīna hum awlā bihā ṣiliyyā
verses.translation: And We truly know best who is most deserving of burning in it

verses.arabicText: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wa-im-minkum illā wāriduhā kāna ʿalā rabbika ḥatmam-maqḍiyyā
verses.translation: There is none of you who will not pass over it. ˹This is˺ a decree your Lord must fulfil

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Thumma nunajjī alladhīna ittaqaw wanadharu ẓ-ẓālimīna fīhā jithiyyā
verses.translation: Then We will deliver those who were devout, leaving the wrongdoers there on their knees

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ayyu l-farīqayni khayrum-maqāmaw-wa-aḥsanu nadiyyā
verses.translation: When Our clear revelations are recited to them, the disbelievers ask the believers ˹mockingly˺, “Which of the two of us is better in status and superior in assembly?”

verses.arabicText: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَـٰثًا وَرِءْيًا
verses.transliteration: Wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum aḥsanu athāthaw-wari'yā
verses.translation: ˹Imagine, O Prophet˺ how many peoples We have destroyed before them, who were far better in luxury and splendour

verses.arabicText: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًا
verses.transliteration: Qul man kāna fī ḍ-ḍalālati falyamdud lahu r-raḥmānu maddan ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna immā l-ʿadhāba wa-immā s-sāʿata fasayaʿlamūna man huwa sharrum-makānaw-wa-aḍʿafu jundā
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Whoever is ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, the Most Compassionate will allow them plenty of time, until—behold!—they face what they are threatened with: either the torment or the Hour. Only then will they realize who is worse in position and inferior in manpower.”

verses.arabicText: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًى ۗ وَٱلْبَـٰقِيَـٰتُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا
verses.transliteration: Wayazīdu l-lahu alladhīna ih'tadaw hudaw-wal-bāqiyātu ṣ-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawābaw-wakhayrum-maraddā
verses.translation: And Allah increases in guidance those who are ˹rightly˺ guided. And the everlasting good deeds are far better with your Lord in reward and in outcome

verses.arabicText: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا
verses.transliteration: Afara-ayta alladhī kafara biāyātinā waqāla laūtayanna mālaw-wawaladā
verses.translation: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ the one who rejects Our revelations yet boasts, “I will definitely be granted ˹plenty of˺ wealth and children ˹if there is an afterlife˺.”

verses.arabicText: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا
verses.transliteration: Aṭṭalaʿa l-ghayba ami ittakhadha ʿinda r-raḥmāni ʿahdā
verses.translation: Has he looked into the unseen or taken a pledge from the Most Compassionate

verses.arabicText: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّا
verses.transliteration: Kallā sanaktubu mā yaqūlu wanamuddu lahu mina l-ʿadhābi maddā
verses.translation: Not at all! We certainly record whatever he claims and will increase his punishment extensively

verses.arabicText: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا
verses.transliteration: Wanarithuhu mā yaqūlu wayatīnā fardā
verses.translation: And We will inherit what he boasts of, and he will come before Us all by himself

verses.arabicText: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّا
verses.transliteration: Wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatal-liyakūnū lahum ʿizzā
verses.translation: They have taken other gods, instead of Allah, seeking strength ˹and protection˺ through them

verses.arabicText: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
verses.transliteration: Kallā sayakfurūna biʿibādatihim wayakūnūna ʿalayhim ḍiddā
verses.translation: But no! Those ˹gods˺ will deny their worship and turn against them

verses.arabicText: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
verses.transliteration: Alam tara annā arsalnā sh-shayāṭīna ʿalā l-kāfirīna ta-uzzuhum azzā
verses.translation: Do you ˹O Prophet˺ not see that We have sent the devils against the disbelievers, constantly inciting them

verses.arabicText: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا
verses.transliteration: Falā taʿjal ʿalayhim innamā naʿuddu lahum ʿaddā
verses.translation: So do not be in haste against them, for indeed We are ˹closely˺ counting down their days

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَفْدًا
verses.transliteration: Yawma naḥshuru l-mutaqīna ilā r-raḥmāni wafdā
verses.translation: ˹Watch for˺ the Day We will gather the righteous before the Most Compassionate as an honoured delegation

verses.arabicText: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا
verses.transliteration: Wanasūqu l-muj'rimīna ilā jahannama wir'dā
verses.translation: and drive the wicked to Hell like a thirsty herd

verses.arabicText: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا
verses.transliteration: Lā yamlikūna sh-shafāʿata illā mani ittakhadha ʿinda r-raḥmāni ʿahdā
verses.translation: None will have the right to intercede, except those who have taken a covenant from the Most Compassionate

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا
verses.transliteration: Waqālū ittakhadha r-raḥmānu waladā
verses.translation: They say, “The Most Compassionate has offspring.”

verses.arabicText: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّا
verses.transliteration: Laqad ji'tum shayan iddā
verses.translation: You have certainly made an outrageous claim

verses.arabicText: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
verses.transliteration: Takādu s-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min'hu watanshaqqu l-arḍu watakhirru l-jibālu haddā
verses.translation: by which the heavens are about to burst, the earth to split apart, and the mountains to crumble to pieces

verses.arabicText: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدًا
verses.transliteration: An daʿaw lilrraḥmāni waladā
verses.translation: in protest of attributing children to the Most Compassionate

verses.arabicText: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
verses.transliteration: Wamā yanbaghī lilrraḥmāni ay-yattakhidha waladā
verses.translation: It does not befit ˹the majesty of˺ the Most Compassionate to have children

verses.arabicText: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَبْدًا
verses.transliteration: In kullu man fī s-samāwāti wal-arḍi illā ātī r-raḥmāni ʿabdā
verses.translation: There is none in the heavens or the earth who will not return to the Most Compassionate in full submission

verses.arabicText: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا
verses.transliteration: Laqad aḥṣāhum waʿaddahum ʿaddā
verses.translation: Indeed, He fully knows them and has counted them precisely

verses.arabicText: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
verses.transliteration: Wakulluhum ātīhi yawma l-qiyāmati fardā
verses.translation: And each of them will return to Him on the Day of Judgment all alone

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وُدًّا
verses.transliteration: Inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti sayajʿalu lahumu r-raḥmānu wuddā
verses.translation: As for those who believe and do good, the Most Compassionate will ˹certainly˺ bless them with ˹genuine˺ love

verses.arabicText: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا
verses.transliteration: Fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika litubashira bihi l-mutaqīna watundhira bihi qawmal-luddā
verses.translation: Indeed, We have made this ˹Quran˺ easy in your own language ˹O Prophet˺ so with it you may give good news to the righteous and warn those who are contentious

verses.arabicText: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
verses.transliteration: Wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hal tuḥissu min'hum min aḥadin aw tasmaʿu lahum rik'zā
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We have destroyed before them! Do you ˹still˺ see any of them, or ˹even˺ hear from them the slightest sound
